records.name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
records.description: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy (SVPNPA) Hyderabad is the premier training institution for IPS officers of the Indian Police Service. All IPS probationers undergo a rigorous foundational training program covering policing, law, weapons, and leadership at this academy. SVPNPA also conducts in-service training programs and international police cooperation courses.

records.name: Foreign Service Institute
records.description: The Foreign Service Institute (FSI) New Delhi is the training institution for Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officers under the Ministry of External Affairs. It provides foundational and in-service training in diplomacy, international relations, protocol, languages, and trade negotiations. FSI also conducts training programs for officers of other services and foreign diplomats posted to India.

records.name: Chanakya IAS Academy
records.description: Chanakya IAS Academy is one of the most well-known UPSC coaching institutes in India, headquartered in New Delhi with branches across major cities. It offers comprehensive coaching for IAS, IPS, and other civil services examinations with a faculty of retired IAS/IPS officers and subject matter experts. The academy is known for its structured study material, test series, and interview guidance programs.

records.name: Vaid's ICS Lucknow
records.description: Vaid's ICS Lucknow is a renowned civil services coaching institute based in Lucknow with decades of experience preparing candidates for UPSC and state PCS examinations. The institute is particularly strong in optional subjects like History, Geography, and Public Administration, and is popular among students from UP and neighboring states. It offers both classroom and distance learning programs along with regular test series.

records.name: Banaras Hindu University
records.description: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Varanasi is one of the largest residential universities in Asia, established in 1916 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya. It offers programs across arts, sciences, engineering, medicine, and social sciences, with its Institute of Medical Sciences and Faculty of Science being particularly renowned. BHU is a central university with a strong legacy in Sanskrit, performing arts, and Indological studies.

records.name: University of Mumbai
records.description: University of Mumbai, established in 1857, is one of India's oldest and largest universities, affiliated with hundreds of colleges across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. It offers programs spanning arts, commerce, science, law, engineering, and management, with particularly strong commerce, law, and science faculties. The university's Fort campus is a UNESCO-listed heritage building and a landmark of Mumbai.

records.name: Loyola College Chennai
records.description: Loyola College Chennai is one of India's most prestigious autonomous colleges, established in 1925 and affiliated with the University of Madras. It is particularly renowned for its humanities, social sciences, and basic sciences programs and consistently ranks among the top colleges in India in NIRF rankings. Loyola is known for its research culture, international collaborations, and social outreach programs.

records.name: Indian School of Mines (IIT Dhanbad)
records.description: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad, formerly Indian School of Mines, is one of the oldest and most respected technical universities in India, established in 1926. It is particularly renowned for programs in mining engineering, petroleum engineering, and geological sciences. Now a full-fledged IIT, it offers a wide range of engineering and science programs with strong industry ties to the coal, oil, and minerals sector.

records.name: Geological Survey of India Training Institute
records.description: The Geological Survey of India (GSI) Training Institute in Hyderabad provides specialized training to GSI officers and geoscientists in geological mapping, remote sensing, mineral exploration, and geohazard assessment. It conducts programs both for in-service professionals and international participants, contributing to capacity building in earth sciences. The institute houses extensive geological collections and is a repository of India's geological knowledge.

records.name: Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology
records.description: Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG) Dehradun is an autonomous research institute under DST, specializing in the geological, glaciological, and seismological study of the Himalayan region. It is one of the foremost institutions globally for Himalayan tectonics, paleoclimate research, and glacial monitoring. WIHG offers Ph.D. programs and conducts field studies in some of the most challenging terrains in the world.
